reviewer: Codex visual inspection and gameplay evidence review
findings: Directional ship silhouette, three rock sizes and bright bullets are distinguishable in the sparse dark field.
Ship and rock shape/orientation art remains legible at native 256x224 resolution; the 2P cyan/red accents distinguish independent ships.
Native 1P and 2P input-policy runs clear all three default sectors and reach cooperative win with retained scores.
Separate behavior checks cover thrust/inertia/brake response, toroidal seam distance, bounded shots, real rock splitting, safe warp, saucer warnings, loss and reset.
limits: DOWN does not visibly change the stationary spawn; the focused moving-inertia brake test verifies its actual function.
The completion pilot emphasizes braking, turning, firing and timed hyperspace; full human flight feel and difficulty are not calibrated by that route.
Admission covers the bundled art/controller footprint; arbitrary 48px art overrides still require geometry review.
No gravity wells, solid terrain, scrolling missions or inventory is supplied.
No human balance study, physical CRT overscan/calibration or badge/controller hardware validation.
